taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: Q-type
Aquifer depth: 49.4 m – 124 m (Layer 5, moderate resistivity zone overlying the resistive basement)
Recommendation: Target the drilling at the 49.4–124 m interval, which represents the most probable water-bearing horizon before the sharp resistivity increase marking the basement/competent rock below 124 m; design casing and screen placement to isolate this zone and avoid penetrating unnecessarily into the underlying high-resistivity (likely unweathered/hard rock) layer.
